task.description: Run the project's full regression test gate (mix letflow.check.test), plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted, for REQ-231 (Entities.Query.Cursor + Entities.Query.FieldGrants) before ORCH proceeds to RELEASE-VALIDATOR / merge.

result.note:
All checks run fresh, real output quoted below.

1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> clean, no output, exit 0.

2. `mix format --check-formatted` -> clean, no output, exit 0.

3. `mix letflow.check.test` (8-way partitioned full suite via scripts/test_parallel.sh):
   - FIRST RUN: hit the known local-sandbox hazard (stale per-partition tenant_template schemas built before this branch's two new migrations existed) -- every partition failed with `relation "tenant_template.entity_field_restrictions" does not exist` / clone_failed on unrelated tenant-fixture-provisioning tests (44-117 failures per partition, e.g. partition-8: 'Result: 318/362 passed, 3 excluded / Failed: 44 tests'). This is pre-authorized hazard #1 from the dispatch instructions, not a REQ-231 regression -- root cause is a build artifact of running tests before this branch's new migrations existed, not a code defect. Cleared it: `DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS tenant_template CASCADE` via `sudo docker exec letflow-1-postgres-1 psql -U letflow -d <db>` against all of letflow_test, letflow_test1..letflow_test8.
   - SECOND RUN (after cache clear): combined result across all 8 partitions -- 3401 passed, 2 failed, 22 excluded (partition sizes: p1=494 passed; p2=352 passed incl 4 properties, 4 excluded; p3=403 passed incl 1 property; p4=550 passed incl 1 property, 14 excluded; p5=406 passed; p6=431/433 passed, 2 failed; p7=403 passed, 1 excluded; p8=362 passed, 3 excluded). The only 2 failures, both in partition-6, are Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest's rust-pin tests ('a matching rust pin reports OK with no mismatch' and 'a mismatched rust pin reports a MISMATCH row naming expected and running'), both `** (ErlangError) Erlang error: :enoent` from `System.cmd("rustc", ["--version"], ...)` at test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs:69/76 -- exactly the pre-authorized known-flaky class (no rustc installed on this host), not a REQ-231 regression. `mix letflow.check.test` exited 1 overall solely because of these 2 known-environmental failures (Mix.raise halts before reaching the isolated wasm_hang/lua_wallclock_race subprocess stages it normally chains).
   - Ran the two isolated subprocess stages manually since the main task halted before reaching them: `mix test --only wasm_hang` -> 'Result: 5 passed, 3420 excluded', 0 failures (expected GenServer timeout/error log noise from the plugin-handler hang test itself, not a failure). `mix test --only lua_wallclock_race` -> 'Result: 11 passed, 3414 excluded', 0 failures (one unrelated compile-time type-warning at test/letflow/repository_test.exs:250 comparing module atoms with ==, pre-existing, not from this branch).
   - REQ-231-specific targeted run: `mix test test/letflow/entities/query_cursor_field_grants_test.exs test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs --max-cases 1` -> 'Result: 22 passed', 0 failures.

No genuine REQ-231 regression found anywhere in the suite. All failures encountered map exactly to the two pre-authorized known-flaky/hazard classes named in the dispatch (stale tenant_template cache, cleared; no-rustc-on-host toolchain check). No new failure signature was seen.
